name: Shadcn UI Page Builder
summary: Desktop-only drag-and-drop builder that composes full pages from the Shadcnblocks library of shadcn/ui blocks.
description: The page builder inside the Shadcnblocks explorer: compose and edit full pages from the shadcn/ui block library by dragging blocks in from the sidebar. The builder interface renders client-side, so only the shell (title, navigation and first-run state) was readable.
